prompt:
A young man stands on the left side of the scene, facing the viewer, arms
crossed comfortably across his chest, weight even on both feet, wearing a plain
short-sleeved t-shirt, straight trousers and low sneakers. Short tousled dark
hair. A small, easy smile; simple dot eyes. His shirt and trousers are drawn as
clean contours with the paper showing through them, not filled in. Only his
hair and the soles of his shoes are solid black.

To his right stands a simple rectangular desk on straight legs, seen straight
on. On the desk, two identical widescreen monitors side by side, and to their
right an open laptop turned slightly toward the viewer. All three screens show
short horizontal lines of code, left-aligned, with a narrow sidebar of shorter
marks. The monitor bezels and the laptop body are outlines, not filled shapes;
the screen interiors are dark only where the code sits.

Under the right side of the desk, a rectangular tower drawn in outline, with two
or three cables curving loosely from it up to the desk. A small cup of pens at
the far right edge of the desk.

The man, the desk and the tower all rest on a single horizontal ground line. The
man is roughly as tall as the desk is wide. Leave clear space between the man
and the desk.

clean black line illustration on off-white paper, technical drawing register,
confident even contour lines in exactly two weights, outline drawing with the
paper showing through the clothing and the objects, solid black only on hair and
shoe soles, all shading as sparse 45 degree diagonal hatching, flat front facing
view, every object resting on one horizontal ground line, muted desaturated
indigo #5D5D9C only on the code shown on screens, flat uniform #00FF00
background, generous padding around the artwork
